propositions: FAIL remediation guidance at src/rebar/llm/completion.py:48-65 omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite for external evidence admissibility, causing callers to attempt ticket-only retries that cannot satisfy untagged external criteria by contract.
ADR 0043 and completion_verifier.md:81-86 deliberately classify untagged criteria as codebase-verifiable and reject ticket-only external evidence, which is the intended behavior.

The remediation guidance must explicitly state that repository-verifiable criteria require repository evidence while external evidence is admissible only from criteria tagged with [operator-attested], and that untagged external criteria cannot be satisfied by ticket comment alone.

The existing interface test for FAIL remediation guidance must be strengthened to require the canonical codebase-verifiable kind, the exact [operator-attested] tag, and the untagged external limitation to enforce the contract.
